proof.description: Cryptographic proof of wallet ownership. The union is open to allow future proof methods (e.g. ERC-1271, ERC-6492). Each variant bundles its signature with the corresponding message format.

address.description: EVM wallet address (0x-prefixed, with EIP-55 checksum recommended).

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content. The EIP-712 `proof` field proves wallet consent (orthogonal trust statement); `signatures` proves record provenance (e.g. that a platform UI minted this record).

main.description: A verifiable link between an ATProto DID and an EVM wallet address, proven via a cryptographic signature. Currently supports EOA wallets via EIP-712 typed data signatures; the proof field is an open union to allow future signature methods.

message.description: The EIP-712 structured message fields that were signed.

signature.description: ECDSA signature over the EIP-712 hash (hex-encoded with 0x prefix, 64 or 65 bytes).

eip712Proof.description: EOA wallet ownership proof via EIP-712 typed data signature. Contains both the structured message that was signed and the resulting signature.

did.description: The ATProto DID being linked to the EVM address.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID as string (bigint serialized). Identifies which chain was used for signing; for EOA wallets the identity link applies across all EVM-compatible chains.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the attestation was created (bigint serialized).

evmAddress.description: The EVM wallet address (must match the top-level address field).

eip712Message.description: The EIP-712 typed data message that was signed by the wallet. Contains the fields binding an ATProto DID to an EVM address on a specific chain.
